metadata.description: Official Spanish notary and property-registry arancel schedules for the formalization-cost engine (FASE 5). Supplied at the user's explicit direction on 2026-08-25.
metadata.disclaimer: These schedules apply cleanly to the PURCHASE deed (base = purchase price) — that base is unambiguous. The user's own source flags that the calculation base for the separate MORTGAGE deed (constitution of the loan: capital vs. 'responsabilitat hipotecaria total') could not be confirmed against the consolidated BOE text, so mortgage-deed notary/registry fees are intentionally NOT computed by this engine — see formalizationCosts.ts. Per Llei 5/2019 (LCCI), gestoria costs for the mortgage deed are legally borne by the bank, not the buyer, so no buyer-facing gestoria figure is modeled. No additional 'regional CCAA commission' beyond ITP/AJD (already in mortgageData.json) was found to exist.

notaryFeeSchedule.source: Reial Decret 1426/1989, vigent el 2025 (aranzel dels notaris).

registryFeeSchedule.source: Reial Decret 1427/1989, vigent el 2025 (aranzel dels registradors de la propietat).
